title: #63 - Suspicions Of The Nobles Of The Reach
content:
#63 - Suspicions Of The Nobles Of The Reach

Chapter 63 Doubts from the River Bay Nobles

Desmond looked at the surprised reaction of the River Bay nobles and the misbehavior of several people around him, and he was immediately quite proud.

Even if you are all earl heirs, viscounts, etc., haven't you heard of Arthur's legend?

"Too outrageous, I can't believe it."

"If I killed dozens of enemies, I can still explain that I am ignorant and try to accept it. But three hundred people, isn't this too fake?"

Several noble children in the River Bay did not believe Desmond's words.

Desmond raised his index finger and shook it, pretending to be indifferent:

"In the final analysis, it's still you who stay in the River Bay and don't come out, and you don't know the wonders of this world. You know, Mr. Arthur is a real god of war, the kind of one-man army."

The coach of Riverrun boasted about the lord of the Red Mill, but it didn't convince people.

Loras was attracted by the exclamation before. After listening for a while, he found that they were talking about some experiences of the handsome young man next to him.

So he asked directly: "It sounds like this coach of Riverrun is talking about your story?"

"Yes." Arthur did not deny it and briefly recounted the conflict with the Blackwood family a month ago.

He emphasized that he was the victim, and then went to Riverrun to complain and the subsequent war.

"In fact, I killed only a hundred enemies on the spot, and the rest were killed by the hot and humid weather and quack doctors. You also know that those monks and bachelors who followed the army were the doctors with the least skills. It was simply difficult to rely on them to heal cuts and arrows."

Arthur restored the situation at that time more objectively.

There is another reason for saying this, that is, the Rose Family is also a noble family that treats civilians better, and the Knight of Flowers is a middle school boy with a strong sense of justice.

This can win the other party's favor.

Throughout the continent of Westeros, there are many families that are nobles who value reputation and cherish their reputation. Not only do they have low taxes, but they also love their subjects.

For example, the Stark Wolf family in the North, the Mormont Bear family on Bear Island, and the Tyrell Rose family in the River Reach can barely be counted as such.

Although Arthur guessed that his family's move was to win over the hearts of the people, after all, the Rose family's historical heritage is not very deep, and there is no gap with other great nobles in the River Reach. Only in terms of being close to the people, his family is at the forefront of the nobles in the River Reach.

But it also really benefits the subjects.

In terms of deeds, not heart, the Rose family can still get along.

"I admire your courage. If it were me, I would not dare to fight with 500 people and enemies three times my own." Loras had a better impression of the man in front of him, but he still had some doubts in his heart, but he didn't show it.

After all, those who can kill three or five enemies are already top players on the battlefield, and those who can kill about ten enemies can be worthy of being a vanguard general.

If he could kill dozens of people in one battle, he would definitely be famous throughout the continent, and the bards of later generations would also sing his story.

As for people like Arthur Dayne, the Sword of the Gods, who knocked down his five Kingsguard brothers while peeing, he could be the ceiling of the entire continent for a period of time.

Of course, the Sword of the Gods is the best in the continent in single combat, but in a crowded battlefield, warriors like Arthur Bracken and Robert, who are able to perform miracles with great strength, have stronger lethality.

Because the hammer is inherently better at breaking armor than the greatsword.

Loras did not doubt Arthur's words on the surface, but it was obvious that others were still not convinced.

"But we haven't seen Mr. Arthur show his might, so how do we know this is true?"

"That's right, I only saw this baron cut off Sir Marin Tran's sword with one sword, which doesn't prove what Desmond said is true."

"Everyone can brag, including you rivermen."

"As the foot binding cloth of the Seven Kingdoms, the Riverlands may only have one man, Sir Brynden Tully, the Blackfish, and the rest... hum!"

A group of first- and second-tier nobles in the Riverlands around Arthur expressed their contempt.

It's no wonder they reacted like this, because the Riverlands were originally the lowest end of the Seven Kingdoms' war power contempt chain.

If it was someone else who was despised, Arthur might have endured it, but he was questioned, and he felt angry.

He turned to the River Reach nobles who spoke very aggressively, "Why, do you want to test my skills?"

A tall brown-haired knight stood up, "Try it, don't think I'm afraid of a little baron like you."

Another man who looked very similar to him also stood up and kept in line with the people around him:

"It's just cutting off a sword, what's the big deal, and now you want to deceive Ser Loras with a false story that I don't know how to make up. I really can't stand people like you."

The two men were very resentful that Arthur sat next to Loras as soon as he arrived. They were relatives of the Knight of Flowers and the core children of the first-line nobles in the River Reach, but they only sat in a row behind the main seat.

"These are the twins Horace and Hopper of the Redwyne family." The Knight of Flowers first explained to Arthur softly.

Then he turned to the two of them and made peace in a calm tone: "Two sirs, treat our guests in a friendly way and don't let them think we are barbarians like the Dothraki."

Although these three are knights, the difference in status is easy to show.

After Loras spoke, the two twin brothers obviously restrained themselves.

Although they still looked dissatisfied, they sat down obediently.

"Let's continue to talk about ways to increase strength." Seeing that the situation had eased, Loras returned to the previous topic.

Arthur shook his head, "No, no, no, I think it's time to give these two knights some life experience, so that they know not to rush to question what they don't understand."

The Lord of the Red Mill wanted to show his true strength in front of Loras and many noble children of the River Bay, first to convince this group of people, and second to cultivate his own fans.

Like Desmond and Patrick, the fans of the tap water will publicize their achievements wherever they go.

After making a name for themselves, many things will be easier to solve.

Loras was puzzled, and his handsome face was full of doubts.

He asked: "Are you going to challenge one of them?"

After hearing what Arthur and the Knight of Flowers said, the two brothers became restless again.

"Why, you still want to fight me?"

"Any one of us brothers can beat you, a liar full of lies!"

Arthur shook his head, "You misunderstood my meaning."

After a pause, in the shocked eyes of many nobles in the Bay, he said to the two:

"You two come together, I, Arthur, have nothing to fear?"
